title: Survey of AlphaFold 3 Multimer Models for Recent Medium-Resolution Cryo-EM Maps
content: AlphaFold 3 (AF3) has recently demonstrated high accuracy predicting multimeric protein models [1]. The deep learning models of AF3 are capable of predicting protein complexes that contain multiple copies of proteins, ligands, nucleic acids, ions, and modified residues. AF3 supports a much broader range of applications than AlphaFold 2, which was previously recognized as the best-performing method for predicting single-chain protein models in the past Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP) conferences. However, the actual accuracy is yet to be investigated for broader data sets, particularly the cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps that often contain molecular complexes involving proteins and nucleic acids.
